Towering sequoia grove: colossal ribbed clay trunks in burnt sienna, thumbprinted bark texture, enormous root buttresses humping the forest floor, scattered clay fern fronds, deep shadow pockets between trunks, layered canopy silhouettes overhead.

Layered badlands hoodoos: tall tapered clay spires in banded ochre, rust and cream, tool-carved horizontal strata lines, crumbling ledges, loose clay pebble scree at bases, a vast dry sky-open plateau stretching behind.

Glowing mushroom forest: bulbous clay caps in cobalt and violet, stippled gills underneath, clusters at varied heights, luminous pale stalks, soft clay moss carpeting the ground, dense mycelium ridges threading between stems.

Amber-pine forest: slim clay conifers with scored bark, fanned needle-clusters in sage and olive, sticky amber droplets sculpted as translucent orange beads along trunks, deep needle-litter floor in warm tan, rolling forest hills behind.

Misty cloud-forest plateau: flat elevated clay table edged with sheer cliff faces, trailing wispy clay mist coils clinging to ledges, dense low fern tufts, rounded mossy boulders, soft grey-green palette throughout, cool and still.

Broad mirror lake: smooth pressed clay basin in slate-blue, ringed by sculpted muddy shoreline with thumb-pushed ripple marks, low rounded clay hills behind, tall horsetail reeds in clusters of rolled clay rods along the bank.

Flowering meadow: undulating clay ground in warm green, dozens of tiny pinched wildflowers in crimson, yellow and white, scattered fern rosettes, a gentle clay hillock at center, open and bright with no shade canopy above.

Crystal cavern: arched clay cave interior, stalactites hanging in pale grey-blue, floor-rising stalagmites, sculpted geode clusters cracked open showing layered crystal rings, rough tool-marked ceiling, dim cool atmosphere, no light source depicted.

Desert dune field: sweeping smooth clay dunes in warm sand-yellow, knife-blade ridgelines, wind-ripple texture scored across slopes, occasional bleached clay bone fragment half-buried, deep shadow troughs between crests, utterly waterless and still.

Redwood canyon trail: narrow clay gorge between towering straight-trunked redwoods, root webs bridging the path, deep russet needle carpet on the floor, shafts of implied light cutting between trunks, elevated clay ridge visible at the far end.

Terraced clay-pool cascades: stepped clay terraces in cream and mineral-orange descending a hillside, shallow circular geothermal pools brimming in each tier, steam wisps curled in raw clay, mineral crust texture pressed around every rim.

Mossy boulder field: vast rolling field of rounded clay boulders in grey and charcoal, each draped in thick sponged green moss texture, low fern fronds tucked in gaps, no trees, wide open sky implied, ground dry and rough.

Fern jungle: dense emerald clay canopy of arching fronds layered at every height, broad cycad crowns spreading wide, thick clay vine ropes looping between stems, soft forest floor mounded in decomposing clay leaf litter, saturated green throughout.

Coastal cliffs: sheer clay cliff face in white and pale gold, horizontal sediment lines scored across, clay surf foaming in rough textured white waves at the base, shallow tide-pools scooped into rocky ledge, salt-spray mist implied.

Volcanic rock field: sharp jagged clay lava formations in matte charcoal and red-black, chunky aa-texture pressed all over, dead bleached clay tree stumps partially engulfed, glowing orange cracks painted into deep crevices, harsh and barren.

Amber resin grove: gnarled ancient clay conifers with deeply fissured bark, thick amber bead clusters oozing down every trunk in translucent orange clay, thick root tangles gripping rocky soil, dry leaf litter, sunlit golden atmosphere implied.

Rainbow geothermal springs: irregular clay hot-spring pools banded in vivid orange, yellow, cobalt and white mineral rings, bubbling texture across each surface, sculpted steam wisps, elevated clay vent cones at center, stark mineral terrain around.

Frozen tundra lake: wide flat clay ice sheet in pale blue-white, surface cracked into polygon plates with pressed lines, clay icebergs tilting at the shore, bare clay ground in grey-brown radiating outward, cold and barren, no vegetation.

Towering mesa plateau: flat-topped clay mesa rising on sheer vertical walls, banded in red, orange and cream strata, narrow clay ledge paths spiraling upward, wind-eroded clay arches at the rim, bone-dry scrubland below.

Mangrove wetland: arching clay prop-roots descending into murky olive-clay water, tangled root lattice at every angle, thick humid clay canopy above, shallow tidal mud floor with thumb-pressed ripples, moss draping every surface.

Glowing bioluminescent night swamp: dark clay ground with still black-clay pools, sculpted glowing fungi and lily pads in pale blue and aqua, hanging clay moss threads dripping from low branches, eerie calm, muted dark palette throughout.

Canyon river delta: deep clay canyon carved in layered terracotta walls, rushing river of textured blue-grey clay splitting into braided channels at the base, clay rapids ridged across the flow, sediment bars of pale clay at the mouth.

Pine-needle forest floor: ancient clay conifers with thick plated bark, deep carpet of scored needle texture in warm rust-orange, fat clay pine cones scattered at root bases, low growing clay moss cushions on fallen logs, dry and hushed.

Deep canyon badlands: knife-cut clay ravines dropping between towering walls in banded rust, purple and cream, no water anywhere, wind-scoured ledges, dry clay rockfall debris piled at canyon feet, dramatic and exposed under open sky.

Terraced fern hillside: broad clay hill rising in gentle sculpted terraces, each level thick with dense arching fern fronds in varied greens, exposed red clay banks between tiers, rounded clay boulders embedded mid-slope, lush and deeply layered.
